result: For a teacher f*(x) = Σ aᵢ|w*ᵢ·x| with Gaussian inputs, a wide two-layer ReLU net trained by (truncated) gradient descent reaches population loss O(1/d^{1+Q}), while any polynomial-size kernel or feature method, NTK included, is stuck at Ω(1/d): training that moves the features provably beats the kernel regime.
result_plain: Beyond NTK: GD on a two-layer net learns |W*x| teachers to o(1/d) loss; every poly-size kernel method has Ω(1/d).
